tvShow.name: Catch! Teenieping
tvShow.overview: Set free on Earth, fairies with magical powers begin influencing people's emotions. Now, it's up to a princess from a faraway kingdom to stop them!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Romi, formerly residing in the Emotions Kingdom, has to go on Earth to catch all the Teeniepings she accidentally released. To carry out her mission, she has to become a normal girl of Harmony Town, living and working in the Heartrose Bakery, and has to lead a double life. While she spends most of her time with her new friends or the Royal Teeniepings, she has to transform into a princess as soon as she sees a freed Teenieping around, as they like to wreak havoc in all of Harmony Town and try everything to not be caught!

seasons.name: Twinkle Catch! Teenieping
seasons.overview: The Jewel Teeniepings, special jewel-themed Teenieping residing in the Jewel Forest, are all released on Earth by a mysterious masked Teenieping by the name of Maskping. Romi, who now lives a normal life in Harmony Town, gets once again in charge of catching them all, accompanied this time by three very immature Teeniepings studying at the Teenieping School, led by the Royal Teeniepings (excluding Heartsping) who returned in the Emotions Kingdom.

seasons.name: Secret Catch! Teenieping
seasons.overview: The Key Teeniepings, special Teeniepings residing in the Mystic Village of the Emotions Kingdom, are once again released on Earth by Jennie, with more cruel intentions than ever! As the evil princess settles in the now-deserted Mystic Village, Romi gets in charge of catching them all, with the help of the three Royal Key Teeniepings, and of a mysterious Teenieping locked in a chest, whose identity remains a secret...
